name: FLA_MISCELLANEOUS_PAYMENTS_INT
description: FLA_MISCELLANEOUS_PAYMENTS_INT contains the data of miscellaneous payments.

columns.name: INTERFACE_MISC_PAYMENT_ID
columns.description: Interface miscellaneous payment identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Business unit to which the miscellaneous payment refers.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number refers to the lease identifier for which the miscellaneous payment is created.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number refers to the asset identifier for which the miscellaneous payment is created.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Payment template name. References the template from which the payment term and other attributes are copied.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type. Values are derived from ORA_FLA_PAYMENT_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose. Values are derived from ORA_FLA_PAYMENT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code. This is entered by the user.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate used to derive the payment amount when the payment currency is different from functional currency.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of the miscellaneous payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount. This is entered by the user.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer account number of the payment.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill-to customer address site number. Site number represents a location in the system.

columns.name: SHIP_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Ship-to customer account address site number. Site number represents a location in the system.

columns.name: VENDOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Physical location of the supplier.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_1
columns.description: Account concatenated segments. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. This will capture the Non-compliance Expense Account in case of Expense lease payment and the Receivables Account in case of Revenue lease payment.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_2
columns.description: Account concatenated segments. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. This will capture the Payables Liability Account in case of Expense lease payment and the Revenue Account in case of Revenue lease payment.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_3
columns.description: Account concatenated segments. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. Reserved for future use.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION_4
columns.description: Account concatenated segments. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. Reserved for future use.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which miscellaneous payment is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which miscellaneous payment is being imported

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the Import Job. Main Job Request ID.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for the lease if row is processed or rejected

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the purpose of miscellaneous payment. Possible values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: MISC_PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of miscellaneous payment. Possible values are MANUAL.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action being taken on the miscellaneous payment. Possible values are NEW and UPDATE.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier for which the payment is created.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill-to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill-to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship-to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier. It is referenced from POZ_VENDORS table.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Payment template identifier. References the template from which the payment term is copied.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Asset identifier for which the payment is created.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID_1
columns.description: Account code combination identifier. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. This will capture the Non-compliance Expense Account in case of Expense lease payment and the Receivables Account in case of Revenue lease payment.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID_2
columns.description: Account code combination identifier. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. This will capture the Payables Liability Account in case of Expense lease payment and the Revenue Account in case of Revenue lease payment.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID_3
columns.description: Account code combination identifier. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. Reserved for future use.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID_4
columns.description: Account code combination identifier. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this miscellaneous payment. Reserved for future use.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier to be sent to Receivables.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name used to deriving the transaction type identified for Receivables.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Currency conversion type when the currency is different from the functional currency.

columns.name: MISC_PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Miscellaneous payment identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_NAME
columns.description: Payment term name used to derive the payment term identifier of Receivables or Payables.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier for calculation of due date.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_FLAG
columns.description: Intercompany flag with possible values as Y or N. Mainly used for reporting purposes

columns.name: PRIMARY_INTENDED_USE
columns.description: Tax Driver: The purpose for which a product may be used. The actual use is stored at the distribution level.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Tax classification code for payment term.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Tax Driver: Indicates whether tax is included or not.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Identifies the taxable nature of a noninventory based item for tax determination or tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Tax Driver: Product fiscal classification

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Type of product. Possible values are Goods and Services. This value defaults from Inventory Item attributes or is entered by the user.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Transactions category assigned by user.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.description: Tax Driver: Fiscal Classification.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Withholding tax group identifier.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Tax Driver: Used to apply multiple withholding taxes to an invoice line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Deploying company's Tax Registration number

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: Tax Driver: First party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Bill-to Customer Tax Registration Number

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: Tax Driver: Third party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
